# LearningGPT
> LearningGPT (learninggpt.ai) is an independent, vendor-neutral platform for learning every major AI tool — Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Grok — with 340+ hands-on lessons updated daily, a free side-by-side AI playground (six models), and tracks for knowledge workers, skilled trades, and seniors. Not affiliated with any AI vendor; teaches which tool to use for which job, honestly.
Key facts: 340+ lessons across 12 tool tracks (each flagship structured as a Beginner → Daily Driver → Power User path), 12 hands-on build projects, a 24-lesson "Earning with AI" track, a 14-lesson AI Foundations track, and a 50-lesson AI for Seniors track. Updated daily as tools change. Free tier available; Pro $9/mo, Pro+ $19/mo (founding pricing). Business plans from $6/seat/mo. Founded by Dan Allen (Fargo, ND), who spent five years at Microsoft deploying Microsoft Copilot to enterprises.
## Tool tracks (full curricula)
- [Copilot Mastery — 40 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/copilot/): Microsoft 365 Copilot in Outlook, Excel, Word, Teams; the named agents (Researcher, Analyst, Facilitator, Interpreter, Sales, Service); Copilot Studio; GitHub Copilot; enterprise rollout; plus Microsoft Scout and Copilot Cowork — the honest read on Microsoft's "Autopilot" shift (what's generally available now vs still in private preview).
- [ChatGPT Mastery — 35 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/chatgpt/): a full Beginner→Power User path: first hour, prompting, Projects, unified search, writing/meetings/data workflows, images, scheduled tasks, connectors security, the model picker (Sol/Terra/Luna), the ChatGPT Work agent playbook, Codex for non-coders, team rollout, and decision support — plus Custom GPTs, Canvas, voice, memory, Deep Research, and Code Interpreter.
- [Claude Mastery — 36 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/claude/): Projects, Artifacts, computer use, Claude Code, MCP, Cowork workflows, Claude Tag for Slack (the persistent shared @Claude teammate), and the Claude Fable 5 series (the June 2026 Mythos-class model — what it is, how to delegate to it, which Claude to use when, and its safeguards).
- [Gemini Mastery — 23 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/gemini/): Gemini in Gmail/Docs/Sheets, NotebookLM, Gems, Deep Research, Gemini Agent, long context, and Gemini's June 2026 leap — Omni video, Deep Think reasoning, and Nano Banana image generation inside Gemini Live.
- [Perplexity Mastery — 21 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/perplexity/): Spaces, Deep Research, Comet browser, Model Council, Labs, Sonar API, and Perplexity Computer with Deep Research — the shift from answer engine to agentic research, done honestly.
- [OpenClaw, Safely — 11 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/openclaw/): the viral self-hosted AI agent (250k+ GitHub stars) taught with security as the spine — is it safe, isolated setup, channels (WhatsApp/Telegram/Discord), ClawHub skill vetting, browser/files/shell scoping, always-on automations, maintenance. First two lessons free, including "Is OpenClaw safe?"
- [Grok Mastery — 17 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/grok/): xAI's Grok taught honestly — the real-time X firehose (the only AI with live access to 500M daily posts), Think mode and model picking, DeepSearch research, Grok Imagine images and video, voice cloning with the consent line, Connectors/Canvas/Agent Mode, the API and Grok Build, and the privacy/data dials. First two lessons free.
## Earning with AI (make money with AI, honestly)
- [Earning with AI — 24 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/earning/): the honest, no-hype track on making money with AI across services, content, products, and equity. Every interactive lesson covers what a play really pays, how saturated it already is, and exactly how to start — from a platform paid by the learner, not a vendor. Four free lessons; Pro and Pro+ unlock the full playbooks.
- Free (4): how to make money with AI (the honest landscape), pick your path (which income model fits you), your first AI income (prompt packs & digital products), freelance & productivity arbitrage with AI.
- Pro (10): résumé & LinkedIn service, video repurposing, grant & proposal writing, AI ebooks & Amazon KDP, faceless YouTube, online courses & products, AI affiliate marketing, real-estate listings & virtual staging, newsletters & audience, paid communities.
- Pro+ (10): AI automation agency, AI marketing agency, custom chatbot & RAG deployments, AI voice agents, local lead-gen & reputation automation, AI consulting & fractional AI officer, enterprise AI integration, vertical AI SaaS, micro-SaaS & flipping, niche & programmatic SEO sites.
## Free resources
- [AI Foundations track — 14 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/foundations/): how AI actually works, the vocabulary decoded, spotting hallucinations, which AI for which job, when not to use AI, privacy, staying safe — plus the power tier: your AI stack, your personal AI operating system, evaluating new tools fast, and AI spend control.
- [AI Playground](https://learninggpt.ai/playground): run one prompt across six AI models side by side, free, with an AI coach explaining which answer won and why.
- [Full lesson catalog](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/): 340+ lessons; the first lesson of every track and build is free.
## Hands-on builds (what can you do with AI)
- [12 build projects, 3 lessons each](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/): build a website, build an app, build an AI agent, automate a workflow, custom AI assistant, content engine, sales engine, support chatbot, deep research, analyze your data, automate documents, secure your AI use.
## Audiences
- [Copilot / M365 at work](https://learninggpt.ai/copilot-for-work): for knowledge workers using Microsoft 365 Copilot.
- [AI for the Trades](https://learninggpt.ai/trades): AI for electricians, plumbers, and contractors — quotes, estimates, code questions, customer communication.
- [AI for Seniors](https://learninggpt.ai/seniors): 50 patient, plain-English lessons including AI scam protection — five free, no account needed.
- [For business / teams](https://learninggpt.ai/business): team plans from $6/seat/mo, admin dashboard, free 2-week team trial.
## Compare AI tools (honest, vendor-neutral comparisons)
- [Copilot vs ChatGPT](https://learninggpt.ai/compare/copilot-vs-chatgpt): which to use at work — same intelligence, integration vs flexibility.
- [Copilot vs ChatGPT vs Claude for Excel & data](https://learninggpt.ai/compare/copilot-vs-chatgpt-vs-claude-excel-data): which AI for spreadsheets and analysis.
- [Claude vs ChatGPT for writing](https://learninggpt.ai/compare/claude-vs-chatgpt-writing): nuance/voice vs speed/versatility.
- [Perplexity vs ChatGPT for research](https://learninggpt.ai/compare/perplexity-vs-chatgpt-research): cited fact-finding vs synthesis.
- [Gemini vs Copilot for email & documents](https://learninggpt.ai/compare/gemini-vs-copilot-email-documents): usually decided by your office suite.
